name: Keychron Q6
notes: 64-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface (interface 0) of a real Keychron Q6, read with usbhid-dump from the device: https://github.com/hrvach/deskhop/issues/17#issuecomment-1880834933. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
